goal: 让对方了解你家乡的天气特点

n1.speaker: 同学 Tom
n1.line: Where are you from, Li Hua? I am from Shanghai.
n1.lineCn: 李华,你来自哪里?我来自上海。

grammar.name: 形容词作表语
grammar.note: be + 形容词构成主系表结构,用来描述主语的状态或特征,如 It is cold、Shanghai is big。

options.text: I am from Harbin. It is very cold and snowy in winter there.
options.textCn: 我来自哈尔滨。那里冬天非常冷,而且多雪。
options.feedback: 说出家乡并用形容词 cold、snowy 描述天气,话题顺利展开。
缺少 be 动词,应该是 I am from Harbin。
等于没有回答,对方完全不知道你的家乡。

n2.speaker: 同学 Tom
n2.line: Wow, Harbin! Is it really cold there?
n2.lineCn: 哇,哈尔滨!那里真的很冷吗?

grammar.name: 程度副词 very/really
grammar.note: very、really 放在形容词前加强程度,如 very cold、really strong,副词不随名词变化。

options.text: Yes, very cold! In winter it often snows, and the wind is really strong.
options.textCn: 是的,非常冷!冬天经常下雪,风也很大。
options.feedback: 用 very、really 生动描述家乡冬天,信息具体丰富。
形容词没有复数形式,cold 不能加 -s,应该只说 very cold。
回答敷衍,没有任何有用的描述。

n3.speaker: 同学 Tom
n3.line: Oh, I see. What is the weather like in your hometown?
n3.lineCn: 哦,我明白了。你家乡的天气怎么样?

grammar.name: 询问天气句型
grammar.note: What is the weather like? 是询问天气的固定句型,回答用 It is + 形容词,如 It is warm and sunny。

options.text: In spring it is warm and sunny. In summer it is hot and rainy.
options.textCn: 春天温暖晴朗。夏天炎热多雨。
options.feedback: 用 It is + 形容词回答了天气,还分季节描述,非常清楚。
等于没说,对方仍然不了解你的家乡。
回避话题,无法描述家乡天气。

n4.speaker: 同学 Tom
n4.line: That sounds different from my city! What about autumn and winter?
n4.lineCn: 听起来和我的城市不一样!那秋天和冬天呢?

grammar.name: 副词修饰动词
grammar.note: 副词修饰动词时放在动词之后,如 It snows heavily,heavily 说明雪下得很大。

options.text: Autumn is cool and dry. In winter it snows heavily, and the city becomes white and beautiful. I love my hometown!
options.textCn: 秋天凉爽干燥。冬天雪下得很大,城市变得又白又美。我爱我的家乡!
options.feedback: 完整描述了四季天气特点,形容词副词运用正确,目标达成!

options.text: Winter has snow. Autumn has leaves.
options.feedback: 信息太少,没有说出天气的特点。

options.text: I do not know about autumn.
options.feedback: 描述不完整,对方还是不了解你的家乡。

success.speaker: 同学 Tom
success.line: Harbin sounds amazing! I want to visit it in winter.
success.lineCn: 哈尔滨听起来太棒了!我想冬天去那里玩。

fail1.speaker: 同学 Tom
fail1.line: Hmm, maybe you can tell me more next time.
fail1.lineCn: 嗯,也许你下次再给我多讲讲。

fail2.speaker: 同学 Tom
fail2.line: Okay... I still do not know much about your city.
fail2.lineCn: 好吧……我还是不太了解你的城市。
